title: Galremos
summary: Galremos breaks into smaller pieces as increasingly large magmite groups appear.
overview: Galremos breaks into smaller pieces as increasingly large magmite groups appear.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Keep add control ready for the large final two waves.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Magmites spawn at 90%, 60%, 35%, 20% and 5% health, in groups of one, two, one, four and six respectively.
Each threshold also reduces Galremos's size.
Five minutes out of combat removes magmites and resets the health sequence.

notes: Approval E303. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
